notes.title: Level lobbies with players are now highlighted in online mode
notes.notes:
Hey All - Until we reach critical mass, it can be difficult to find others to play against online. Watch for highlighted levels to find games with other players waiting in the lobby for a game to start.

Highlight looks like this...
http://imgur.com/yfcGjYK
